title: Red Lentil and Carrot Burgers
description: Vegetarian burgers made from red lentils, grated carrot, egg and breadcrumbs with a touch of sweet chilli sauce. Serve with guacamole.

steps.text: Cook the lentils in water for about 10 minutes until soft but still holding their shape. Drain in a sieve and cool well.
Transfer the lentils to a bowl, add the grated carrot, sweet chilli sauce, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and mix.

Heat a frying pan with a little oil, shape a small test patty and fry for about 1 minute on each side. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Cover the mixture with cling film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to firm up.
Take the mixture out of the fridge about 15 minutes before cooking. Shape into 4 large flat burgers or 12 small ones.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat, add oil to a depth of 0.5 cm and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden.
For large burgers, cover the pan, reduce the heat and steam for about 5 minutes. Serve with guacamole.
